# f5xc_discovery (Resource)

Service discovery in F5XC performs following<br><br>Dynamic service discovery: Resolving the load balancer endpoints for a ADC cluster<br>Dynamic VIP discovery: Publishing virtual IP to attract traffic from clients

To get more information about f5xc_discovery, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/discovery)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Discovery - Basic

resource "f5xc_discovery" "example" {
  name        = "example-discovery"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Discovery basic example"

  cluster_identifier_choice = {
    no_cluster_id = true
  }

  where = {
    ref_or_selector_choice = {
      virtual_site = {
        internet_vip_choice = {
          disable_internet_vip = true
        }
        ref = [{
          name      = "ves-io-all-res"
          namespace = "shared"
        }]
      }
    }
  }

  discovery_choice = {
    discovery_consul = {
      access_info = {
        connection_info = {
          api_server = "consul.example.com:8500"
        }
      }
      publish_info = {
        publish_choice = {
          publish = true
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.access_info.config_type_choice.connection_info`

Required:

- `api_server` (String) Discovery Service API server API server must be a fully qualified domain string and port specified as host:port pair<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(262)`

Optional:

- `tls_info` (Attributes) TLS parameters TLS settings to enable transport layer security (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info))

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.access_info.config_type_choice.connection_info.tls_info`

Optional:

- `certificate` (String) The TLS certificate URL. Client  certificate is PEM-encoded certificate or certificate-chain.
- `key_url` (Attributes) Private Key Client private key file containing data in PEM format including the PEM headers. The data in this key file has to match accompanying certificate. The data may be optionally secured using BlindFold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url))
- `server_name` (String) Server Name ServerName is passed to the server for SNI and is used in the client to check server certificates against. If ServerName is empty, the hostname used to contact the server is used<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(256)`
- `trusted_ca_url` (String) Server CA certificates The URL or value for trusted Server CA certificate or certificate chain Certificates in PEM format including the PEM headers.

### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.access_info.config_type_choice.connection_info.tls_info.key_url`

Required:

- `secret_info_choice` (Attributes) SecretInfoOneof Secret can be one of the following types - * Blindfold Secret - Secret is managed by F5XC Secret Management System * Clear Secret - Secret is not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url--secret_info_choice))

Optional:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))

Optional:

### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.access_info.k8s_pod_network_choice`

Optional:

- `isolated` (Boolean) isolated Specifies Kubernetes POD network is isolated from VER. In this mode NodePort is discovered when Kubernetes cluster is external and ClusterIP is discovered when Kubernetes cluster is in InCluster mode.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_discovery.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = "f5xc_discovery.example"
}
```
